answer: Resist sybils with bonded proof-of-unique-personhood plus stake slashing: each agent must lock a refundable bond and pass a liveness-linked credential issued by independent verifiers, slashed if duplicate identities are proven. Like a spiral ledger, attestations chain together so a canyon of fake accounts cannot fork trust without paying a bond per identity, and an atlas of verifier signatures makes duplicates publicly auditable. An attacker creating 1,000 fakes must fund 1,000 bonds and risk forfeiture, turning cheap duplication into a linear, expensive cost.
